corrections.text: The article's "What We Don't Know" section states that The Hacker News's reporting does not specify the exact affected version ranges for the Oracle Database (Oracle Text) and Oracle REST Data Services flaws. In fact, The Hacker News's article includes a summary table giving exact ranges: Oracle Text (CVE-2026-114819) affects versions 19.3-19.32, 21.3-21.24, and 23.4.0-23.26.3; Oracle REST Data Services (CVE-2026-91609) affects versions 24.2.0 to 26.2.1.
